toyCarrier.model: toric/surface-code patch with alternating e-condensed and m-condensed boundary segments

tests: Yang-Baxter braid relation U1 U2 U1 = U2 U1 U2
fusion-parity readout before and after code deformation

controls: uniform e-condensed boundary has no e/m junction fusion qubit
uniform m-condensed boundary has no e/m junction fusion qubit
removing a pair of junctions halves the unconstrained fusion-space dimension
local perturbations that do not close the gap may split finite-size states only exponentially

promotionBoundary.provedByToy: the e/m condensation fork and sqrt(2) interface admit local stabilizer-code preparation, fusion readout and braiding
promotionBoundary.notProvedByToy: the parent chiral algebra is V_Lambda^+, the m-condensed edge is V-natural, or the twist is the Monster 2A defect
promotionBoundary.nextJoin: place the same boundary selection and interface protocol on the Leech coupled-wire carrier, then demand the zero-current and J-character gates
